cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You brought soup? I'll cook your dinners all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then when I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring them back full, with a bigger freezer. That should put me ahead.
